THE CITY · Rich and poor in coins and food: Qwen
Coins and food together. The rich Qwen are topped up with both every night and split their days between farming and gathering; they make 7 children. Five poor founders die, and 50,754 food spoils over 400 days.
100 founders · 400 days · no government · seed 1 · qwen
